name: variants
description: Socrates again, written the way a real Claude may honestly write it: the sort and predicates in Vocabulary.lean without docstrings and with a NAMED presupposition instance, the constant at the top of Inbox.lean, the statements as `def` with their value on the next line, a stray blank line under one card (the freeze is refused naming the blank line; removed; frozen), and the proof as a tactic block in Main.lean. Every variant passes; the first gate attempt passes.
subject: Demo

steps.newString:
namespace Demo

axiom Being : Type
axiom Being.exists : Nonempty Being
instance instNonemptyBeing : Nonempty Being := Being.exists
axiom Human : Being → Prop
axiom Mortal : Being → Prop

end Demo

namespace Demo

/-- Socrates -/
noncomputable opaque socrates : Being

steps.oldString:
natural_name: All humans are mortal
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
steps.newString:
natural_name: All humans are mortal
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/

/-- All humans are mortal -/
def all_humans_are_mortal : Prop :=
  ∀ x : Being, Human x → Mortal x
axiom all_humans_are_mortal.holds : all_humans_are_mortal

steps.oldString:
natural_name: Socrates is a human
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
steps.newString:
natural_name: Socrates is a human
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
/-- Socrates is a human -/
def socrates_is_a_human : Prop :=
  Human socrates
axiom socrates_is_a_human.holds : socrates_is_a_human

steps.oldString:
natural_name: Socrates is mortal
premises: all-humans-are-mortal, socrates-is-a-human
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
steps.newString:
natural_name: Socrates is mortal
premises: all-humans-are-mortal, socrates-is-a-human
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
/-- Socrates is mortal -/
def socrates_is_mortal : Prop :=
  Mortal socrates

theorem socrates_is_mortal.holds : socrates_is_mortal := by
  unfold socrates_is_mortal
